intent: preview-only background concepts; no production changes

concepts.name: Faceted slate
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup; precise-object-edit of an existing website screenshot.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the CURRENT lizz.dev studio portfolio, exact desktop page.
Image 2 is only a background STYLE REFERENCE: the Chop Farms webpage's subtle dark low-poly faceted ground. Do not copy its pixel font, video player, battle image, logo or layout.
Primary request: make the lizz.dev BACKGROUND a little more lively with restrained low-poly environmental detail. Change ONLY the empty background behind and around the website. Return one polished, believable, flat full-page desktop website concept screenshot, same landscape canvas and geometry as Image 1, about 1440x1000.
INVARIANTS: preserve all existing content, exact wording, glyphs, fonts, type sizes, navigation, the round yellow/green gecko mark, all icons, columns, equal margins, section coordinates, and spacing from Image 1. The sidebar stays aligned with Projects. Preserve Work, Writing, About, Contact, home@lizz.dev, X, YouTube. Games remains selected, with Chop Farms and muted grayscale Clankerfront marked Stalled. Keep the actual blog preview text and date. Do NOT add Never Sleep to the visible Games list. Do NOT introduce a footer, new headline, cards, borders, ornaments, buttons, new content, or floating UI.
Keep the existing #172128 dark slate ground, off-white typography and readable secondary type. Low-poly means matte triangulated surfaces and carefully simplified isometric geometry from a small indie strategy game, not a wireframe or a sci-fi grid. The background should suit both apps and games while retaining a professional studio feeling.
Very important: protect the full text areas and icons. Environmental imagery is low contrast, visible enough to judge but always much less prominent than project art. No tree silhouette or high-contrast triangle behind any letter or clickable link. Most central background stays quiet.
Avoid: photorealism, stock nature photos, bright green foliage, neon, glow, particles, noise/grain, blurry gradients, a full-screen game screenshot, excessive ornament, web browser chrome, mock device, perspective view of the website, comparison panels, labels like "Concept A" inside the website. No additional explanation text in the image.

BACKGROUND DIRECTION 1 — VERY RESTRAINED. A quiet, almost tone-on-tone faceted ground texture made from irregular low-poly triangular planes in nearby slate colors (#172128, #1b2a32, #1b2d33), directly inspired by the faceted background outside the trailer in Image 2. Use broad irregular low-relief facets about 60–150px across, with a natural distribution and no visible seam or geometric outlines. Most texture is in the lower third and outside margins; it becomes imperceptible near the text. Keep upper center especially calm. NO literal trees in this variant: show how far just beautiful low-poly terrain can take the studio page. Restrained but not so invisible the experiment cannot be seen. Do not change the UI.
